CustomField.description: System-set: TRUE once this BAN has been referenced (tagged) by any Quote. Once TRUE the BAN currency is locked (VR_BAN_Currency_Locked). One-way — never reset, because a BAN can serve multiple quotes.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Set automatically when a quote uses this BAN. Once set, the BAN's currency is locked.
CustomField.label: Tagged To Quote
